test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In surrogacy cases, the surrogate as well as the commissioning mother may be granted maternity leave of how many days, in case either or both of them are government servants, as per new rule passed by the Indian Government in June 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**180 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Government** has introduced a new rule in **June 2024**, granting maternity leave for both the **surrogate mother** and the **commissioning mother** in surrogacy cases.
 
• As per this rule, **180 days** of maternity leave can now be availed by government employees in these roles.
 
• The decision was taken to recognize the **physical, emotional, and mental demands** of motherhood, irrespective of whether it is through natural birth or surrogacy.
 
• This measure ensures **gender equality** and supports the concept of **work-life balance** for women in government service.
 
• It is a step in alignment with India's commitment to **maternal health** and the **rights of women** as highlighted in **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• The rule acknowledges that both the surrogate and commissioning mothers play crucial roles in the **childbirth process**, requiring adequate rest and recovery time.
 
• The provision applies specifically to **government servants**, reflecting progressive steps toward **inclusive maternity benefits** in the workplace.
